newsitem.title: USA: Union Pacific completes Resources spinoff.
newsitem.headline: Union Pacific completes Resources spinoff.

text.p: Union Pacific Corp said directors declared a special stock dividend of the remaining Union Pacific Resources Group Inc common shares held by the corporation.
The dividend is payable October 15 to holders of record September 26, including holders of the Union Pacific shares issued in the Southern Pacific merger, the company said.

Based on the number of Union Pacific shares outstanding, it said, shareholders would receive about 0.847 Resources share for each Union Pacific share held, with the definitive percentage being determined after the record date.
Union Pacific said it has received an IRS ruling that the distribution will be tax free for the corporation and its shareholders.
